sf-is-disabled.description: No .sf-is-readonly here: it duplicated :read-only for real form controls,

is-hidden.description: Hides the element (display: none). Toggled by JS or ARIA.

is-invisible.description: Makes the element invisible but still occupies space.

is-visible.description: Forces visibility: visible on a hidden element.

is-disabled.description: Marks the element as non-interactive. Reduces opacity and blocks pointer events.

is-readonly.description: Marks the element as read-only. Reduces opacity; pointer events still active.

is-loading.description: Indicates the element is in a loading state. Shows a spinner cursor.

is-current.description: Marks the element as the current item (e.g. active nav link).

is-expanded.description: Marks the element as expanded (e.g. accordion open).

is-open.description: Marks the element as open (e.g. dropdown visible).

is-valid.description: Marks a form field as passing validation.

is-invalid.description: Marks a form field as failing validation.

is-required.description: Marks a form field as required.

is-error.description: Marks the element as being in an error state.

is-success.description: Marks the element as being in a success state.

is-warning.description: Marks the element as being in a warning state.

is-info.description: Marks the element as carrying informational state.

is-scrolled.description: Applied by JS when the page has scrolled past a threshold.

is-truncated.description: Truncates text with an ellipsis (single line).

is-sr-only.description: Visually hidden but accessible to screen readers.

sf-bento.description: Auto-fill bento grid for card dashboards. Children span 1 column by default; use span modifiers (sf-bento-wide, sf-bento-tall, sf-bento-full, sf-bento-featured) to break the grid.

sf-bento--2.description: Bento grid variant with a 2-column base layout.

sf-bento--3.description: Bento grid variant with a 3-column base layout.

sf-bento--6.description: Bento grid variant with a 6-column base layout.

sf-bento--compact.description: Bento grid variant with shorter default row height.

sf-bento--tall.description: Bento grid variant with taller default row height.

sf-bento-wide.description: Span modifier for a bento item: spans 2 columns (wide card).

sf-bento-full.description: Span modifier for a bento item: stretches across all columns (full-width banner).

sf-bento-tall.description: Span modifier for a bento item: doubles the row height (tall card).

sf-bento-featured.description: Span modifier for a bento item: takes up 2×2 cells (featured hero placement).

sf-surface.description: Generic semantic surface: applies --sf-surface-color as the background and automatically sets a contrasting text color. Tone variants (--primary, --action, etc.) activate preset palettes.

sf-surface--primary.description: Surface variant using the primary brand color palette.

sf-surface--secondary.description: Surface variant using the secondary brand color palette.

sf-surface--tertiary.description: Surface variant using the tertiary brand color palette.

sf-surface--action.description: Surface variant using the action color palette (button/CTA primary color).

sf-surface--neutral.description: Surface variant using the neutral palette (muted/gray).

sf-surface--inverse.description: Surface variant that inverts light/dark, creating an always-dark surface in light mode and always-light in dark mode.

sf-surface--success.description: Surface variant using the success status palette.

sf-surface--warning.description: Surface variant using the warning status palette.

sf-surface--error.description: Surface variant using the error status palette.

sf-surface--info.description: Surface variant using the info status palette.

sf-surface--danger.description: Surface variant using the danger status palette.

sf-overflow-fade.description: Adds a gradient fade at the inline-end of an overflowing element to hint at hidden content. Use inside sf-reel or any scroll container.

sf-no-tap-highlight.description: Removes the mobile tap highlight color (-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent). Use on interactive elements with a custom active state.
